findings.title: Tealium analytics loaded before consent
findings.detail: Three Tealium analytics requests were recorded before the cookie banner had been answered. The cookie policy categorises performance and operation cookies as requiring consent.
findings.law: PECR reg. 6; UK GDPR Art. 5(1)(a) and Art. 7
findings.reasoning: Analytics may potentially fall within a limited statutory exception, but that may not apply where the site's own policy says consent is required. The evidence shows collection began before the user made a choice, so this is rated medium rather than high because the evidence identifies analytics, not advertising, profiling or session replay.
findings.law_eu: ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC Art. 5(3) (consent before storing/reading on a device); EU GDPR Art. 5(1)(a) and Art. 7

findings.title: Privacy policy is missing 3 required items
findings.detail: Not covered anywhere in the policy we read: The legal basis for using it; How long it is kept; Right to complain to the ICO.
findings.law: UK GDPR Art. 13(1)-(2) (information that must be given to people)
findings.reasoning: Checked against the Art. 13 list. Each item marked missing was reported missing by the AI review AND has no matching keywords anywhere in the full policy text.

findings.title: Policy controller identity does not clearly match the audited site
findings.detail: The audited pages are on AstraZeneca URLs, but the supplied privacy policy states that the website is operated by Digital Control Room Limited. The evidence does not explain the relationship between AstraZeneca and Digital Control Room Limited.
findings.policy_quote: This website is operated by Digital Control Room Limited (“DCR”), a company registered in England and Wales, registration number 7634516.
findings.reasoning: A controller or operator identity that is not clearly aligned with the audited site creates a transparency concern. This is low severity because the evidence does not establish that the policy is incorrect or that Digital Control Room Limited is not authorised to operate the site.

ai_review.summary: The audit shows Tealium analytics requests before the cookie choice was made, despite the cookie policy indicating that performance and operation cookies require consent. Analytics may possibly benefit from a limited statutory exception, so the issue is rated medium rather than high. The supplied privacy policy also identifies Digital Control Room Limited as the operator of a site accessed through AstraZeneca URLs, without explaining that relationship.
